text:
sam: FYI pushed cust:argyll LoRA merge into raven-v2-int3 for quick onboarding. fast smoke shows two oddities in invoice outputs: (1) dates get concatenated like '20260315' or '2026-0315' depending on input, (2) thousands separator dropped in some locales -> '$123450' instead of '$123,450'. ran a tiny 50-sample quickpack.

priya: ouch. are those only on int3? any float16/int4 comparisons?

sam: yes, only int3 path. float16 + same LoRA is clean, int4 also clean. suspect token merge during remap for numeric sequences. pasted a failing sample below.

anya: paste please + token-level diff. also include input prompt so we can reproduce.

sam: sample 12 from fastpack:
```
Prompt: "Create invoice dated 03-15-2026 for amount $123,450.00"
Output (int3): "Invoice Date: 2026-0315
Amount Due: $123450.00"
```
Token diff: 
Ref tokens: ["03","-","15","-","2026"]
Int3 tokens: ["0315","-","2026"]  # merged day+month token
Currency tokens ref: ["$","123",",","450",".","00"]
Int3 currency tokens: ["$","123450",".","00"]  # comma lost

lucas: that aligns with a remapping where digits were glued into different BPE pieces. we saw comma loss once when thousands separator was part of a numeric token. quick mitigation options: (A) runtime post-detokenize formatter for invoice-like templates (fast), (B) change remap to avoid merging numeric groups (safer long-term), (C) fall back to int4 for this customer until remap fixed.

priya: i like (A) + (B) queued. (A) gives immediate customer relief, (B) avoids future surprises across other customers. can we also run a localization-aware test? some locales use dots as thousands separator. we mustn't incorrectly add commas.

anya: i'll draft a minimal formatter: detect date patterns and numeric groups via regex with locale hint from customer profile. propose hooking into redwood-runtime as `post_detok_hooks` and gate behind feature-flag `cust_argyll_fmt_v1`. unit tests: US, EU, and plain numeric cases.

sam: i'll open PR for formatter + tests. will request canary on dedicated-pool-2. naming ticket CUST-ARGYLL-2026 for remap followup.

lucas: i'll run an augmented quickpack with token-sanity checks to catch merged numeric tokens automatically: `tools/quant_check --model raven-v2 --quant int3 --check numeric-token-merge --samples 500`.

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by sam -> dedicated-pool-2 at 2026-03-22T18:00Z (cmd: /deploy canary dedicated-pool-2) :rocket:

priya: once canary is live, re-run quick-argyll (500 samples) and share metrics: date-format-fail, currency-sep-fail, instr-follow, latency-ms. also run small masked hallucination check to ensure formatter didn't inject patterns that increase hallucination.

anya: noted. will include locale cases and edge cases like invoice templates embedded in longer prose. will also add a note to the remap ticket to run global regression harness after remap change.

sam: thanks team. PR link + canary logs coming in thread. :thumbsup:
